"'''Naga Sadow's Experiment'''" was an enormous [[mutant]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] who was experimented on by Naga Sadow using [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] around [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]] in Sadow's hidden [[Naga Sadow's fortress|fortress]] on the [[Moon/Legends|Moon]] [[Khar Shian]]. Follow Sadow's defeat at the [[second battle of Korriban]], and Sadow's subsequent exile to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], the Experiment was abandoned in stasis on Khar Shian. The Experiment subsequently lay dormant until the [[Battle of Khar Shian]] c. [[3622 BBY]], where [[Eternal Alliance]] forces entered the Fortress, which was controlled at the time by the [[Hidden Chain]]. The Experiment subsequently awoke and started to attack people, but was killed by [[Jekiah Ordo]], who was driving a [[Basilisk (Mandalorian)|Basilisk]] at the time.<ref name="Monstrosities">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Naga Sadow's Monstrosities}}</ref><ref name="Legacy Reborn"/>
